title: Slope field: $y' + y = x$ (logistic-like)
caption_md: A first-order linear ODE has an integrating-factor solution. Here we visualize a logistic-style equation $y' = 0.5y(1 - y/10)$: the slope field shows where $y$ grows toward the carrying capacity $y = 10$. Drag the dot to set $y(0)$ — anywhere below 10 grows up to it; anywhere above decays down.
